ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels making up the remaining 15% concentrated at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity central zone; high-intensity white mapping detected as a solid patch on the far right lobe tip and as a fragmented, mottled band along the distal left trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 45 degrees and a vertical depth of approximately 50 pixels from the adjacent peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks is higher on the inner lobe margins approaching the median notch compared to the outer tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distal margins exhibit a concave sweep leading to acute-angled tips; trailing edge lobes follow a segmented convex path towards the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, circular, bumpy pixel formations are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, exhibiting a rougher texture than the primary fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant clusters of raised, light-colored anomalies (consistent with barnacle colonization) located on the distal ends of both lobes; visible indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe near the tip.
